variables.C: lane-specific relational/structural scalar; not identified with mass density
variables.Phi: effective response scalar; not temperature, metric, or information
variables.Q: proposed material response rate; distinct from Core Eulerian Pi
variables.Pi: Core Eulerian rate reconstructed from Q and u; equals Q only when advective rate vanishes
variables.u: new independent solenoidal fluid velocity, not scalar-gradient readout
variables.rho0: separate constant reference inertia coefficient; not C
variables.R_gen: derived trace only; no state or feedback edge
variables.mu_C: variational derivative of Omega with respect to C
variables.mu_Phi: variational derivative with respect to Phi
variables.p: pressure multiplier enforcing div u=0; zero mean gauge in reference
variables.J_C: scalar source with zero integral in closed conserved lane
variables.J_Phi: external response drive; its work is Q J_Phi/M_Phi
variables.F_ext: external fluid force density; work is u dot F_ext
variables.Omega: normalized scalar free-energy functional; no automatic SI energy meaning
variables.E: normalized total reference functional including fluid and rate inertia
variables.D: integrated nonnegative reference dissipation, distinct from tensor D_u
variables.f: scalar free-energy density, including gradient terms
variables.f_rev: reciprocal force density determined conditionally from advective work
